caveats: Mean longitude is a slot coordinate, not a miss distance. Two objects sharing a mean longitude are routinely tens of kilometres apart, kept so by eccentricity- and inclination-vector separation this track does not model. This lane is not a conjunction warning and does not replace one.

The catalogue is a lower bound, never a census. A transfer executed below 0.010 deg/day is invisible, and 33% of the catalogued events had no visible initiating change. Absence of an alert is not evidence of absence of an approach.

geoLeak.sentence: The GEO catalogues remain uncontrolled. This trigger fires 3,812 times inside 517,391 days of provably uncontrolled motion -- 0.288 [0.279, 0.298] of the rate it fires on objects that can manoeuvre, against a bar of 0.10. A rung precision measured here is a property of this detector on this catalogue, not a rate at which objects of a class do anything.
